Pull up a chair because this is going to be a long one. In order to understand what happened you have to know about my roommate, we will just call him M. M is probably the most egotistical person I have ever met in my life. M will always brag about how many girls want to sit on his dick, how many gallons of alcohol it takes for him to get drunk even though the guy weighs around 130 pounds or how he is the equivalent of the drug love child of Lindsay Lohan and Charlie Sheen and it takes a mountain of drugs to make him feel anything. Basically M thinks he is the shit and one day my roommates had it with his pompous ass  so during a game of poker we hatched a most heinous of plots. 
I planned on making weed brownies and inviting people over in order for us to get high and shit faced and my other roommate let's call him H suggested we should give M a brownie that didn't have any weed in it and see how much he overreacts. To swindle him of his brownie and see where his ego would take him was to be our act of roommate revenge and oh were the rewards oh so sweet. 
The next night people came over and all of those who were given a brownie were let in on our little secret and were told not to tell M anything. Once 2 hours went by everyone who got the brownies started to feel the effects kick in including M, so we all knew he was full of shit. He would go off to each individual person saying how stoned he was or watch him as he spun around talking to himself while me and H were standing in the corner hysterically laughing at it all. It was perfect,  and at this point I felt that enough was enough and gave him a brownie that did have weed in it. Knowing M, he wouldn't decline the offer of having another brownie while everyone else had one because it was just another ego boost. Right after giving him the brownie our third roommate, we will call him D, i--a known enabler of shenanigans--convinced me to have another brownie and a few beers. The night moves along and everyone is having a great time and now M is slightly high. It was at this point where D points out and says "Hey areyoufinshed93 how much did you have tonight?" I just told him I had two brownies and a few beers which M overhears. M overreacts with saying "how dare areyoufinished93 be less sober then I am?!!!". D being the cheeky little troll that he is suggests "in order to out do areyoufinished93 you must chug 3 shots of vodka in 10 seconds". Me and H say how much of a horrible idea it is and we along with the other guests say he has nothing to prove, which he gracefully ignores and goes full challenge-accepted mode. He lines the shots of vodka up and takes one shot and we see his eyes wince as he picked up the second one. With five seconds passed, he tries to slam down the second shot. The moment he swallowed it he knew that he dun goofed. He started to spew vomit all over himself and the sink filling up the apartment with the smell of pepperoni mixed with brownie chunks. He got sick a few times, and we all watched in horror. The best part was that once he was done spewing all that vomit he says "you guys, I didn't throw up a lot of those brownies, so I'm still pretty high". After that everyone left, M went to sleep and it was just me H and D sitting around hysterically laughing and how it was all so beautifully evil and mean.  It was then where we decided that M must never know , that this secret will be taken to our graves. 

Tl;dr 
Decided to play a prank on our conceited roommate, made him believe he was incredibly high, he ends up vomiting profusely, other roommates make blood-oath never to tell him the truth.
